primary_variables.matched_definition: Mechanical stretching, cyclic strain, or deformation of cells or tissues.
evidence: we examine the time-dependent response of primary human mesenchymal stem cells (hMSCs) to cyclic tensile strain (CTS).
Cells were strained for 1 or 2 h at, low-intensity (0–4% strain at 1 Hz), intermediate-intensity (0–4% strain at 2 Hz), or high-intensity (2.6–6.2% strain at 5 Hz).

primary_variables.matched_definition: Reduction of gene expression by RNA interference, antisense, shRNA, siRNA, CRISPRi, or related approaches.
evidence: We quantified the effects of siRNA-mediated knockdown (KD) of SUN2 on primary hMSCs by MS
The siRNAs depleted SUN2 to 35% of scrambled controls

primary_variables.matched_definition: Increased expression of a gene, protein, mutant, construct, or transgene that defines the comparison.
evidence: The proteomes of Y201 cells were quantified with doxycycline-induced OE of SUN2 to 160% and 410% of control levels.

primary_variables.matched_definition: Chemical treatment using a compound that inhibits enzyme, receptor, channel, transporter, pathway, or complex function.
evidence: we combined 5 Hz CTS with a panel of ion channel inhibitors: GdCl3, a broad-spectrum inhibitor of stretch-activated ion channels; RN9893, an inhibitor of transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 4 (TRPV4); amiloride, an inhibitor of acid sensing ion channels (ASICs), and GsMTx4, an inhibitor of piezo channels
